name: Tessera Industries Micro-Hologram Projector MHP-3
description: A pocket-sized holographic projector that creates a 30 cm cube of volumetric imagery, sufficient for displaying 3D maps, schematics, faces, or small-scale tactical models. The MHP-3 is a personal information display device that replaces flat screens with true 3D visualization, interfacing with neural implants for direct data input. Users project building blueprints, rotate 3D models of equipment, display facial identification holos, and visualize tactical situations in miniature. The device has become standard professional equipment for engineers, investigators, and tactical planners.

specifications.input: Neural interface or wireless data connection

story_hooks: An MHP-3 found at a crime scene was still projecting when investigators arrived — it displayed a 3D map of the building with entry and exit routes marked, a complete tactical plan left behind by the perpetrators.
MHP-3 projectors have been hacked to display subliminal images within their normal holographic output — users are seeing content they did not request, embedded in their legitimate projections.
